observed_original_abi.calling_convention_observation: The receiver is read from ECX at 0x00c47181 LEA ESI,[ECX + 0x1E8]. One stack dword is read at 0x00c4719d MOV EAX,[ESP + 0x8] with ESP = entry-4, so the operand is [E+4]. 0x00c471b0 is RET 0x4, so the callee pops that one word. Ghidra's void __thiscall with a single undefined4 parameter matches.
observed_original_abi.return_semantics: No return value. EAX is clobbered by 0x00c471a8 MOV ECX,EAX and is dead on exit.

stack_arguments.declared_use: PUSH EAX at 0x00c471a2, as an argument to 0x00B3D2A0
stack_arguments.actual_use: NONE. 0x00B3D2A0 is exactly MOV EAX,dword ptr [0x0167EAE4] ; RET (two instructions, six bytes) and consumes no argument. The pushed word therefore survives 0x00c471a3 and becomes the SECOND stack argument of 0x00BB59B0, which ends in RET 0x8.
stack_arguments.note: One dead word pushed and one live word pushed. The compiler folded the unused argument away without removing the push, because the push is what positions the two arguments 0x00BB59B0 needs.

observed_original_abi.hidden_this_register: ECX is consumed once; the receiver is then reached only through the address held in ESI.

observed_mechanics: 0x00c47181 LEA ESI,[ECX + 0x1E8] forms the address of the manager slot. ESI holds it for the whole body and is passed to 0x00BB59B0 as its third argument.
0x00c47187 MOV ECX,dword ptr [ESI] / 0x00c47189 TEST ECX,ECX / 0x00c4718b JZ 0x00c4719d: the null check is on the OCCUPANT, not on the receiver. A null receiver faults at 0x00c47181.

0x00c4718d MOV dword ptr [ESI],0 clears the slot BEFORE the virtual call. This is load-bearing: the call at 0x00c4719b still receives the old pointer only because ECX, loaded at 0x00c47187, is never reloaded from memory.

0x00c47193 MOV EAX,[ECX] / 0x00c47195 MOV EDX,[EAX + 0xC0] / 0x00c4719b CALL EDX: virtual call at vtable slot +0xC0 with ECX = the evicted occupant and NO stack arguments. Nothing is pushed before it and nothing is popped after it, so the callee pops zero words.
0x00c4719d MOV EAX,[ESP + 0x8] with ESP = entry-4 reads the caller's stack argument.
0x00c471a3 CALL 0x00B3D2A0: that function is MOV EAX,dword ptr [0x0167EAE4] ; RET, so it ignores the two pushed words and returns the global manager pointer.
0x00c471a8 MOV ECX,EAX makes that manager the receiver of 0x00BB59B0.

0x00c471aa CALL 0x00BB59B0: it ends in RET 0x8, so it pops the word pushed at 0x00c471a2 (the dead caller argument) and the word pushed at 0x00c471a1 (&slot). It is called as (manager, dead_argument, &receiver->f_1E8).
0x00c471af POP ESI / 0x00c471b0 RET 0x4 restores the one saved register and pops the caller's single stack word.

callees_evidence.reading: MOV EAX,dword ptr [0x0167EAE4] ; RET. Two instructions, six bytes. Takes no argument and returns the global manager pointer.

callees_evidence.name: FUN_00BB59B0
callees_evidence.reading: __thiscall(manager, key, void** slot_io) -> void, 106 instructions. Zeroes *slot_io, then scans the manager's pointer array at manager+0x50 .. manager+0x54 for an entry whose field +0x13C equals the key, assigning that entry to *slot_io. It then calls 0x00b8de30 and 0x00bb5930 on the key, calls 0x00b8de30 again, stores the result, calls 0x00b8dac0 on the key, calls 0x00b8da70 (key - 1), decomposes the result as a packed 12/12/8-bit id against a table at receiver+0xC8, calls 0x00bbaa60 and a slot +0x00 virtual on the result, detaches the previous occupant through slot +0xC0, recurses on itself at 0x00bb5a88, calls 0x00baf130 with the key and the new occupant, re-detaches the previous occupant at 0x00bb5ab9, and finally calls slot +0xBC on the new occupant. Read in full; the internals of 0x00baf130 (810 instructions), 0x00bbaa60, 0x00bb5930 and 0x00b8de30 were not reconstructed.

sdk_correspondence.caveat: Spore-ModAPI is a third-party clean-room reconstruction, not original EA source and not EA documentation. Where it is cited below it supplies CANDIDATE NAMES only. The binary is the sole authority for every offset, constant, branch polarity and call shape asserted in this record.

semantic_contract: Replaces the occupant of a single pointer-sized manager slot at receiver+0x1E8. If the slot is occupied, the slot is set to null FIRST and the object that was in it is then told to detach through vtable slot +0xC0, with no arguments and with the pointer still live in ECX. The function then always forwards to the manager returned by the two-instruction getter 0x00B3D2A0, which reads the global at 0x0167EAE4, passing the slot address as an in/out parameter; 0x00BB59B0 resolves the new occupant by matching a key against the manager's array and attaches it through slot +0xBC. The single incoming stack argument is pushed but never consumed by 0x00B3D2A0; it survives only to become 0x00BB59B0's second argument. Writes exactly one dword, at receiver+0x1E8, and only when the slot was occupied. Saves and restores ESI, pops its own single stack word, and has one early exit.
classification_rationale: Not STRONG_SEMANTIC. The complete body, the ABI including the callee-popped stack word, the field offset, the single write, the early exit and the vtable slot +0xC0 are all read directly from the disassembly, and both callees' ret forms were read live before the stack reconstruction was accepted. Three material elements are bounded: the owning type of the receiver, the concrete callee behind slot +0xC0, and the type of the object at 0x0167EAE4. The semantic reading of slot +0xC0 as a detach hook and slot +0xBC as an attach hook is INFERRED from the symmetry inside 0x00bb59b0, not established. Not STRUCTURAL_ONLY, because the ordering invariant (clear before detach) and the dead-argument fact are behavioural claims that are fully established.
semantic_findings: The slot at receiver+0x1E8 is cleared BEFORE the detach virtual call, and the call still receives the old pointer only because ECX was loaded once at 0x00c47187. Clear after detach would fault on a self-detaching occupant.
The incoming stack argument is dead at the point it is pushed. 0x00B3D2A0 is two instructions and reads nothing, so the word survives and becomes an argument of 0x00BB59B0.
The manager is always the global at 0x0167EAE4. There is no branch and no argument that could select a different manager.
The forward to 0x00BB59B0 happens unconditionally, including when the slot was already empty. This function never leaves the slot alone.
vtable slot +0xC0 is called with NO stack arguments, proven by the absence of any PUSH before 0x00c4719b and any POP after it.
0x00bb59b0 calls slot +0xC0 on the previous holder and slot +0xBC on the incoming one, so +0xC0 and +0xBC form a detach/attach pair within one interface.
0x00bb59b0 reads the occupant's field at +0x13C and compares it to the key, so the occupant carries an identity dword at +0x13C.
0x00b8da70 inside 0x00bb59b0 returns key - 1, which links this manager to the same accessor cluster that 0x00b8dad0 belongs to.
unresolved_questions: What is the owning type of the receiver? No vtable for it was located and the binary has no RTTI. All that is established is the single field at +0x1E8.
What class implements the occupant interface with slots +0xBC and +0xC0, and what are those two methods called? The detach/attach reading is inferred from call symmetry only.
What is the object at 0x0167EAE4? 0x00B3D2A0 reads the pointer but this worker never read the dword or found a vtable for it.

Does 0x00BB59B0 actually use the argument this function pushes? Its first parameter is the manager, so the dead word becomes its `key`, but the reconstruction does not assert what the key does, because 0x00bb59b0's contract was not fully established for that parameter.

Why is the argument dead at the call to 0x00B3D2A0 yet live at 0x00BB59B0? Either the original signature carried a parameter the build ignores, or the compiler reused the slot. Both fit the bytes; neither is established.
What are 0x00baf130, 0x00bbaa60, 0x00bb5930 and 0x00b8de30? They were located inside 0x00bb59b0's body and their ret forms read, but their bodies were not reconstructed.
Is the write to +0x1E8 a release, a clear-for-replace, or a reset of an owning smart pointer? The body does no reference counting of its own.
Twenty of the twenty-two recorded callsites were not individually disassembled.
runtime_gates: No original-process trace exists. A differential run must confirm the occupant's vtable slot +0xC0 does not re-read the receiver's +0x1E8 slot, which is the invariant the clear-before-detach ordering depends on.
The concrete receiver type and the concrete occupant type can only be fixed by observing a vtable pointer in a running process.
Whether the dead argument has any effect requires a run that varies it at a callsite and observes an unchanged result.
